72-Hour Milestone Execution Schedule

Executing an immaculate interior fit-out in an occupied luxury building on Saadiyat Island requires military-grade logistical discipline and quiet, dust-controlled construction:

Phase 1: Hours 0 – 16 · Site Protection, Laser Leveling & Substrate Framing

  • Comprehensive Site Shielding: Floors, adjacent furnishings, and entrance corridors were lined with heavy-duty protective membranes and zip-wall dust containment barriers.
  • Laser Alignment: Optical multi-axis laser levels mapped the living room and media walls, compensating for floor-to-ceiling tolerances.
  • Drywall Substrate Framing: High-gauge galvanized metal stud frameworks were anchored to form the TV feature wall substrate, providing a robust structural anchor for future fixtures and concealed wiring channels.

Phase 2: Hours 16 – 38 · Classical Wall Mouldings (Boiserie) & Concealed LED Integration

  • Precision Mitered Mouldings: Architectural high-density polyurethane wall mouldings were cut with precision 45-degree miters and installed in classical double-frame proportions, elevating the empty wall behind the sofa and television into a sophisticated gallery setting.
  • Hidden LED Lighting Channel: A recessed warm-white (2700K/3000K) architectural LED trough was routed with remote-accessible transformer housing to create a gentle, ambient halo glow across the feature wall.
  • Low-Voltage & Media Recessing: In-wall conduits were installed for power and HDMI cables, ensuring no unsightly wires would ever be visible below the TV console.

Phase 3: Hours 38 – 56 · Joint Caulking, Level-5 Skim Coating & Architectural Painting

  • Zero-Shrink Anti-Crack Caulking: All moulding-to-wall interfaces were sealed with high-elasticity acrylic polymer caulk to accommodate building thermal expansion without hairline fractures.
  • Level-5 Surface Finishing: Multi-pass ultra-smooth plaster skimming, micro-mesh feather sanding, and deep-penetrating primer coats prepared the entire wall surface.
  • Velvety Architectural Matte Coat: Applied two uniform coats of premium washable low-VOC interior paint, achieving a deep, reflection-free surface texture.

Phase 4: Hours 56 – 72 · TV Mounting, Electrical Testing, Deep Cleaning & Handover

  • Secure TV Installation: Precision mounting of the primary large-screen TV onto reinforced internal framing with flush alignment.
  • Electrical Load & Lighting Check: Testing LED dimmer circuits and power receptacles for safety.
  • Deep Cleaning & Snag-Free Handover: Full HEPA-filter vacuuming, polishing of mirrors, dusting of mouldings, and formal walkthrough with the homeowner. The apartment was handed over completely clean, pristine, and ready to enjoy.
